entities.summary: Free warrior communities of the Eurasian steppe frontier — escaped serfs, adventurers, and outlaws who formed self-governing hosts. Cossacks were the shock troops of Russian expansion, the raiders of Ottoman frontiers, and the explorers of Siberia.
